calendar.matters:
HEARING ON ANDREA MICHELLE RIOS HERNANDEZ' PETITION FOR CHANGE OF NAME OF THE MINOR, QUETZALLI AFENI GONZALEZ

Off Calendar May-07-2025 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: Re: Motion to Change Minor's Name without Further Notice to Other Parent

Dept.505; Judge: Andrew Y.S. Cheng; Clerk: K.Valdes: Proceedings reported by "For the Record" commencing at 9:18:58 a.m. and concluding at 9:22:12 a.m.(D505)

Appearances:
Petitioner Andrea Michelle Rios Hernandez appeared in pro per, was placed under oath and testified.

No objects to the proposed change of name were made.
The Court grant petitioner's request to change minor's name without furter notice to other parent.

Minor Quetzalli Afeni Gonzalez is changes to Quetzalli (First Name) Julieta (Middle Name) Rios Hernandez (Last Name)

Proposed Decree Changing Name signed and filed this day.
